summary: a function header may declare at most 8 parameters
instruction: Change request for the A0 front end (lexer and parser): a function header may now declare at most 8 parameters. A header with more is a parse error at its arrow token `->`. The parser reports the first diagnostic as (code, token index), code 1 a parse error and 2 a structure error; token indexes count the tokens of the lexer (comments and spaces make no tokens; each newline is one).
